newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen rising sharply after Dow gain.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen rising sharply after Dow gain.

text.p: Danish share prices were poised for solid advances on Wednesday in the wake of the Dow's 2.1 percent rise on Wall Street following lower than expected U.S. consumer price rises for March.

"We expect to see Danish shares recover today after Tuesday's surprise falls, with the market echoing rising trends in London, Frankfurt and Paris and the index possibly climbing one percent by the close," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index opened at an unchanged 152.16 at 0700 gmt, having closed 0.37 point down on Tuesday.
